title: The Signal House
objective: Relight the storm beacon before the supply boat leaves.

jetty.title: Storm Jetty
jetty.text: Rain needles the black water. The dark signal tower stands above a shuttered keeper's house.

keeper_room.title: Keeper's Room
keeper_room.text: A cold stove, a wall log, and a sealed oil flask remain. Doors lead to the workshop and tower stair.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.text: Salt has eaten the old switchboard. One dry ceramic fuse rests in a drawer.

tower.title: Lantern Room
tower.text: The dead beacon lens faces the storm. The supply boat's horn sounds below.

take_lantern.label: Take the brass lantern
take_lantern.text: You lift the lantern from a hook under the jetty roof.

leave_island.label: Signal the supply boat and leave
leave_island.text: You abandon the dark station and board the waiting boat.

read_log.label: Read the wall log
read_log.text: The last entry says: REPLACE FUSE, FILL HAND LANTERN, THEN TOUCH ITS FLAME TO THE BEACON.

take_oil.label: Take the oil flask
take_oil.text: You take the sealed oil flask.

take_fuse.label: Take the ceramic fuse
take_fuse.text: You take the dry fuse from the drawer.

install_fuse.label: Install the fuse in the switchboard
install_fuse.text: The fuse seats with a clean click. Current reaches the tower.

fill_lantern.label: Fill the lantern with oil
fill_lantern.text: You fill and light the hand lantern. Its small flame holds steady.

light_beacon.label: Light the storm beacon
light_beacon.text: The great lens catches. A white beam cuts across the storm.

beacon.title: Beacon Relit
beacon.text: The supply boat answers with three horn blasts. The island has a keeper again.

left.title: Station Abandoned
left.text: The unlit tower vanishes behind rain as the boat turns for the mainland.

timeout.title: Too Late
timeout.text: The supply boat's last horn fades. The station remains dark.
